opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's priority questions, show relevance, impact, a clear conceptual framework, rigour, appropriate experience, and value for money. Proposals from individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research proposals that contribute to understanding, public debate, policy, and/or practice on tackling racial inequalities, discrimination, and disadvantage in the UK. Proposals from racially minoritised communities and partnership applications are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society, with a focus on inter-generational changes, continuities, and challenges in racially diverse UK.
